title: Marlas Ni Roha Hita On
chord: Em · G · C · D · Em · Am · D7 · E
lyrics:
Marlas ni roha hita on di ari haheheon
Tapuji ma Tuhanta
Haleluya, Haleluya
Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya
Ai nunga hehe Jesus i, naung mate di silang i
Sai puji ma Tuhanta i

Haleluya, Haleluya
Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya
Naung talu hamatean i, setan banua toru i
Tuhanta manaluhon i
Haleluya, Haleluya
Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya

Ai nunga mungkap Surgo i, di angka na porsea i
Ala naung monang Kristus i
Haleluya, Haleluya
Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya, Haleluya
